nom: Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Sculpting Face Serum for Firming & Anti-Aging

segments.oily: The reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found the serum wasn't too heavy for her skin type and reports it caused no breakouts, absorbing without any greasy or oily appearance.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with sensitive dry skin and one with rough, dry patches typical of mature skin, describe the serum as noticeably hydrating, leaving skin soft and plump without irritation or burning.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who also has oily-combination skin and occasional acne, describe the serum as absorbing well without heaviness, crediting it with reduced signs of aging, increased firmness, and easy layering, aside from one dislike of the fragrance.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or rosacea-prone skin report no reaction, irritation, or burning from the serum, including one whose cheeks normally flush and redden with new products.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin, from the late 30s to over 50, report firmer, plumper, more hydrated skin and softened fine lines or crow's feet, with one over 50 specifically noting improvement in the rough, dry patches she normally has.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report subjectively firmer, plumper, smoother-looking skin with fewer visible fine lines after a few weeks of consistent use, including improvement on crow's feet and crepey skin in several cases. However, many reviewers explicitly note their sample size was too small or the trial too short to judge real lifting or firming results, and one cautions that topical skincare will not deliver dramatic sculpting or jawline-tightening regardless of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as hydrating rather than drying, including several with dry skin who report their skin feels soft, plump, and comfortable rather than tight. No reviewer in this set reports the serum causing dryness or a tight, uncomfortable feeling.
concerns.redness: The reviewers who mention redness or flushing say the serum did not trigger a reaction and, in two cases, helped keep existing redness or flushing at bay.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin, including one managing new perimenopausal breakouts, report the serum did not cause any new breakouts or irritation despite its texture and fragrance.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin say the serum absorbs without adding greasiness or shine and wears well under makeup.

aspects.libelle: Hygienic pump packaging, easy to dispense
Layers cleanly under makeup, no pilling

extraits.titre: Unable to Give an Informed Opinion
extraits.texte: It's honestly difficult to give an informed review of this product. I received this as a sample and have been using it daily morning and evening until I ran out. Do I like the feel of it? Yes. Does it feel hydrating on my skin? Yes. Is the scent pleasant? Yes. But, honestly it takes weeks to truly know a products efficacy due to cellular turnover etc, and I ran out within a little over a week. Have I noticed any huge signs of improvement during that time? None. Is my skin transformed? No. I just don't feel it's doing much of anything for me compared to other far less expensive serums I have tried. I do love Estee Lauder products and usually find them quite effective but I would be lying if I said I have noticed a huge difference in the time I was able to use it. There is just no way for me to give an educated or informed opinion. It is far too expensive for me to purchase without knowing the answer to that. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I used this serum twice a day after cleansing for about 5 weeks. It has a light lotion texture, very subtle pleasant scent, and just a little bit hydrates my entire face well. It sinks in and dries down quickly. I have mild rosacea and reactive skin, and it did not cause any kind of reaction at all. I can't speak as to whether the peptides did anything, as they are more of a preventative than a quick fix, but as a hydrating step before moisturizing it worked well. As there are many hydrating options on the market, and inexpensive peptide products, I'd need to see something more for an expenditure of this level to be worthwhile. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

The Revitalizing Supreme+ serum arrived well packaged, especially for a sample. I have combination skin and occasionally struggle with acne, so I was interested to see how it would work for my skin. The pump bottle made it very easy to dispense, and I found that two pumps were enough to cover my entire face. It absorbed well without feeling heavy or greasy. The only thing I would change is the fragrance. I would have preferred a lighter, more pleasant scent, as the serum has a slight smell that I personally didn't enjoy. Overall, I had a good experience with the serum. My only disappointment was that the sample lasted only a few days, so I didn't get enough time to fully evaluate the longer-term results. Still, I enjoyed using it and would be interested in trying the full-size product. I received the product free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This serum glides on easily and absorbs quickly. It has the texture of a light, more serum-y lotion. It is quite hydrating, without feeling greasy or heavy, and leaves my skin feeling plump, moisturized, and dewy without being over the top. It's not too much for my oily skin. I also have acne-prone skin, and it hasn't caused me any breakouts or issues with that. This does have quite a perfumed scent, but that's dissipates quickly once applied. Overall, I do like it and I will have to continue use to see if there's more long-lasting anti-aging effects! I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This works really well with my perimenopausal skin. It does not cause breakouts, which has suddenly become a problem as I've aged into my 40s. My skin has seen good results with firming my crows feet out which is what I absolutely need. It does not cause a reaction to my cheeks which have inflammation and tend to turn red immediately with products and then reduce down. It feels cool and creamy on application. It's not thick and dries down non-tacky. I do not detect a strong fragrance with this product which I love. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

As a mature over 50 year old woman I have tried many serums and this product has definitely been the best I've tried. I've been using it daily for a few weeks now and my skin is looking and feeling smoother, there are less fine lines, and it's more hydrated (when normally it has rough patches and it's dry). It has also helped applying my makeup (it glides on smoothly) so much better too. I highly recommend this serum. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Honestly I thought this serum wasn't going to do much for my face but I sure was wrong. I have really dry skin and this really left it feeling so soft, hydrated, and plump. After using it for a week twice a day it really plumed and smoothed out my lines around my mouth and eyes. This stuff really works. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
